column1: # Divergences for riscos-ql; see README.md. RECOIL supports neither RISC OS nor the
# Sinclair QL. Sprites: compared with `deark -m rosprite` (Deark 1.7.3) as a black box,
# RGBA (Deark adds the mask as alpha): alpha equal and RGB equal where visible, after undoing our pixel-shape repetition.
# QL: rendered and reviewed visually against the Developer's Guide / Dilwyn Jones layouts.
